premise: Pinecone drops from a branch and rolls down the hill, bump bump bump; Squirrel and Hedgehog chase her; at the bottom she has found the sunniest spot in the forest.
inspiration: The Runaway Pancake (folk chase tale), turned: nobody catches or eats the runaway; the roll is a joyride, and it ends in the best spot of all.
lesson: Sometimes letting go takes you somewhere good.

en-US.title: Pinecone Rolls Away
en-US.text: High on a branch sat Pinecone, brown and bumpy and very comfortable. Then the wind puffed. Pinecone {pinecone:wobble} wobbled. Pinecone {pinecone:hop} dropped. Pinecone rolled! Bump, bump, bump, down the hill she went. Wheee! Catch her, cried Squirrel, {squirrel:hop x3} bounding after. I'm coming, puffed Hedgehog, {hedgehog:spin} rolling too, because that is how hedgehogs run downhill. Bump, bump, bump. Faster, faster! Pinecone bounced over a root, {pinecone:hop} boing, skipped past a mushroom, {pinecone:spin} whizzed round a stone, and, plop, stopped. Squirrel skidded up. Hedgehog bumped in behind. Are you all right? they panted. Pinecone looked around. She was in a soft patch of moss, with the sun on her face and a little stream singing next door. {pinecone:sparkle} I'm perfect, said Pinecone. I always wanted to live here. I just didn't know it yet.

es-ES.title: Piña rueda cuesta abajo
es-ES.text: En lo alto de una rama estaba Piña, marrón, rugosa y muy cómoda. Entonces el viento sopló. Piña {pinecone:wobble} se tambaleó. Piña {pinecone:hop} cayó. ¡Piña rodó! Pum, pum, pum, colina abajo. ¡Yupiii! ¡A por ella!, gritó Ardilla, {squirrel:hop x3} saltando detrás. Ya voy, resopló Erizo, {hedgehog:spin} rodando también, porque así corren los erizos cuesta abajo. Pum, pum, pum. ¡Más rápido, más rápido! Piña botó sobre una raíz, {pinecone:hop} boing, pasó junto a una seta, {pinecone:spin} giró alrededor de una piedra y, plof, se paró. Ardilla llegó derrapando. Erizo llegó rodando detrás. ¿Estás bien?, jadearon. Piña miró a su alrededor. Estaba en un lecho de musgo blandito, con el sol en la cara y un arroyo cantando al lado. {pinecone:sparkle} Estoy perfecta, dijo Piña. Siempre quise vivir aquí. Solo que aún no lo sabía.
